name: Deep Learning for Weather and Climate
description: Overview and scope of deep learning for weather and climate; types of meteorological data; perceptrons; feedforward neural networks; optimization; evaluation matrics; weather classification using CNN; RNNs and sequence models for time series prediction; U-net for spatial data segmentation; GANs for data augmentation; physics informed deep learning; uncertainty quantification in predictions; interpretability of deep learning models; societal applications of weather and climate forecast.
